connection_rules.rule: The A8 mixes audio only. It cannot connect, route, merge, power, or translate MIDI devices. Keep MIDI routing outside the A8.

Connect XPS-30 OUTPUT L/MONO or L/R to confirmed line-level mixer inputs, not a microphone input. Begin with both source and channel gain low, and keep phantom power disabled for keyboard connections.
Use a 3.5 mm TRS-to-two-mono breakout from FM-1 headphone output to two confirmed A8 line inputs. Do not put a stereo TRS headphone signal into a single balanced mono input.

Enable 48 V only after confirming the physical switch scope and that every affected input is a compatible condenser microphone connection. Keep it off around XPS-30, FM-1, phones, computers, and line-level sources.
Treat USB capture as one provisional stereo mix until an observed test proves otherwise. Do not plan on isolated multitrack recording or a defined loopback path.
MAIN OUT is a line-level output. Connect it to powered speakers, a power amplifier, or another suitable line-level destination; do not connect passive speakers directly.
